description: Client-side script for the 'Fees' doctype in ERPNext, managing form behaviors, data fetching, and UI interactions related to fee management.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup for the Fees form, setting fetches for fee structure fields.

methods.name: company
methods.description: Updates dimensions based on the company selected.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Initializes queries and default values when the form loads.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Adjusts form properties and adds buttons based on document status.

methods.name: student
methods.description: Fetches current enrollment details for the selected student.

methods.name: make_payment_request
methods.description: Creates a payment request for the student.

methods.name: make_payment_entry
methods.description: Creates a payment entry for the fee.

methods.name: set_posting_time
methods.description: Refreshes the form to update posting time fields.

methods.name: academic_term
methods.description: Triggers updates related to academic term.

methods.name: fee_structure
methods.description: Fetches and sets fee components based on selected fee structure.

methods.name: calculate_total_amount
methods.description: Calculates the total fee amount from fee components.
